name: 85365 · Yuma, AZ
findings: ZIP 85365 (Yuma) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85365 (Yuma) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85365 (Yuma) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
